name: Tongyi UI Agent API
notes: The page (version V0.0.1) documents a DashScope endpoint for the gui-owl app that takes a screenshot URL, a task instruction, a session ID and optional operation hints (add_info), and returns the next action, such as a click or swipe with screen coordinates, with a thought and an explanation. Requests set device_type to mobile or pc and use the model pre-gui_owl_7b; the PC pipeline also names worker, manager, reflector and notetaker models and can enable the reflection and memory agents. The page states that the agent targets phones, in-car systems, TVs and PCs, names no mobile operating system, and lists usage as free for a limited time. The X-PLUG/MobileAgent README links this page as a limited-time free Mobile-Agent-v3 API; the page itself names no paper or released checkpoint, so no relation to the Mobile-Agent or GUI-Owl records is asserted. The receipt uses the Markdown export because the HTML embeds a per-request tracking ID.
summary: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API that returns the next GUI action with its reasoning for a screenshot and task, with a mobile pipeline and a PC pipeline using planner, worker, reflector and memory agents.
